task_message:
Case V48: segment the vascular soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 221x221x351 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case V48 is complete. I segmented the vascular soft-tissue tumor — a markedly T2-hyperintense, lobulated posterolateral distal-thigh mass adjacent to the femoral diaphysis/metaphysis, extending craniocaudally from axial slice ~57 to ~151 with a second posteromedial lobule.

Workflow summary:
- Screened the volume with axial, coronal and sagittal contact sheets to localize the lesion.
- Seeded the model with two positive points in the brightest lobules (v1), accepted intensity-based candidates for bright rims (v2), refined the boundary (v3), then added further genuine bright lesion rims (C1 then C2+C4, v4–v5).
- Verified ends with past-the-mask slices: no lesion beyond either end; outline follows the bright lobules in axial, coronal and sagittal planes.

Final mask: 42.5 mL, single component, saved with medium confidence (slight uncertainty only at the faint inferior/lateral fringe).
